item.title: Steven Spielberg's Mysterious UFO Movie Finally Revealed: Watch The First Trailer For DISCLOSURE DAY
item.description: Steven Spielberg's mysterious UFO movie finally has a title and cast, but that's not all. The first trailer and posters for the filmmaker's sci-fi return has also landed!

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Reviews Land Along With Franchise-Low Rotten Tomatoes Score
item.description: The first reviews for James Cameron's Avatar: Fire and Ash are now being shared online, and the sci-fi threequel has generated an initial Rotten Tomatoes score...

item.title: FALLOUT Season 2 Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed As First Reviews Promises Worthy NEW VEGAS Adaptation
item.description: The first reviews for Fallout Season 2 have entered the Wasteland, but does the show deliver a worthy take on New Vegas? We have details on that and its Rotten Tomatoes score.

item.title: IT: WELCOME TO DERRY Director Andy Muschietti On Pennywise's Origin And What It Means For Season 2 - SPOILERS
item.description: It: Welcome to Derry director Andy Muschietti has explained the revelations about Pennywise the Clown's origin story and what that means for the planned second and third seasons.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Trailer Leaks Online; Features Sadie Sink, The Punisher, [SPOILER], And More
item.description: While we can't say for sure with so many AI fakes flooding social media, it appears the first Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer has surfaced after yesterday's Avengers: Doomsday leaks.

item.title: Cap Is Back! 5 Things We Need To See From Chris Evans' Steve Rogers In AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
item.description: Chris Evans is officially returning as Steve Rogers in Avengers: Doomsday, and these are the things we need to see from Captain America in the movie next December.

item.title: TRON: LEGACY Director Joseph Kosinski Explains Why He Doesn't View TRON: ARES As A Sequel To His Movie
item.description: TRON: Legacy director Joseph Kosinski has broken his silence on this past October's TRON: Ares, and reveals why he doesn't view it as a sequel to his 2010 movie.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Trailer #2 Audio Leaks Online Along With Second Part Of SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Teaser
item.description: Marvel really needs to do something about its security! The second trailer (or the audio, at least) for Avengers: Doomsday has now leaked online, as well as the second part of the Spider-Man: BND teaser.

item.title: WONDER MAN Star Ben Kingsley Reveals IRON MAN 3 Connection And A Deeper Exploration Of Trevor Slattery
item.description: Wonder Man star Sir Ben Kingsley has revealed how the Marvel Television series expands on what we saw in Iron Man 3 and teases Trevor's relationship with Simon Williams.
